Broker — Master (Tier III).

Trade — Shape the story: Seed or smother one rumor across a settlement over a downtime. Standard fee 90 marks (Diplomacy or Soft Power (GM picks by job)).

Trick — Name-Drop (1/scene): Invoke a connection to open one door; the GM decides what string comes attached.

Master step: the Broker's Knack (Fair Price) improves at this tier — see the class entry.
